title: 78. How can I extract the Draft answers?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How can I extract the Draft answers.
short_answer: On your Dashboard you can see the number of the saved Draft contributions for your survey. Your participants have the option to save their work as a Draft and continue the filling in a later time. According with our privacy policy, as a form manager you are not allowed to extract the Draft answers.
